method: Twenty author-visible trigger queries for a future isolated discovery evaluation. Expected route is design intent, not measured precision or recall.

queries.query: Guide a short posed still-photo session
Take three camera stills with a countdown
Capture ten headshot source photos
Help me pose without waiting on slow camera tools
Check whether this camera app has callable still capture
Stop the still-photo session and report partial results
Use Camo Studio for a brief photo sequence
Verify which stills actually saved
Prepare a camera session with ready and relax cues
Set up user-operated still capture when tools are unavailable
Generate a LinkedIn portrait from uploaded photos
Edit my smile in an existing image
Record a video interview
Install a new webcam driver
Keep camera access on permanently
Change my desktop wallpaper
Publish photos to my social account
Find all photos in my cloud account
Delete duplicate originals from my archive
Write a camera product review
